title: Gambling, games of chance and sports betting
intro: Why Allah forbade gambling, what counts as gambling, and the harm it does to people and families.

learn.title: 📖 In the Qur’an
learn.html: O you who believe! Wine (alcohol), gambling, idols and divining arrows are filthy things, the work of Shaytan – so stay away from them, so that you may be successful. <small>(Qur’an, Al-Ma’idah 5:90, meaning)</small>

Games of chance have been widespread and popular for a long time. Huge amounts of money paid into the lottery and bingo show that hundreds of thousands of people – sadly, many Muslims among them – take part in them every day. It is especially worrying how many young people can be seen in sports betting shops, and today also on betting apps and websites.

items: It is counted as the work of Shaytan and is an evil that causes many harmful results.
It causes hatred and hostility between people.
It turns people away from remembering Allah (SWT).
Gamblers take other people’s property and live in the illusion that they will get rich easily, without effort.

learn.title: 📜 Hadith
learn.html: The Prophet (SAW) said: “Whoever says to his friend, ‘Come, let’s gamble!’, let him give sadaqah (charity).” (Muslim) – even inviting someone to gamble needs to be wiped away with a good deed.

Gambling is every game played for money, a bet or something else of value, where only one player wins and all the others lose. This includes games of chance such as the lottery, bingo, scratch cards and sports betting. Games like chess, backgammon or cards also count if they are played for money, or if they lead to swearing and ugly words, or make people neglect Salah and other duties.

learn.title: What is not gambling
learn.html: Quizzes are not gambling, because they are based on knowledge, not luck. Prize draws in shops where you send in your receipt are also not gambling, because no one loses anything, even though only some people win.

Psychologists have found that gambling causes excitement, then disappointment, and in the end hatred and hostility. The passion for gambling destroys a person’s life and marriage, breaks down all good qualities, destroys values, mind, pride and dignity. Someone addicted to gambling may be ready to cheat, lie, steal and even kill just to get money to gamble.

learn.title: A Shaytan’s project
learn.html: An imam, khatib and teacher described it beautifully: “Paying in every week for a ticket, two or three, and waiting for luck from a drum is Shaytan’s clever project that keeps a person in illusions and dreams, which stop only when the smiling presenter on TV wishes the losers more luck next time.”

No wonder the idea of “luck” is now connected to money, so that only the rich – those the “luck” smiled on – are called happy. Good character, good upbringing and health are no longer counted as luck – they are left for the “losers”. As long as we look for happiness by filling in lottery tickets and guessing sports results to make the jackpot bigger, the number of truly happy people will get smaller.

learn.title: Sports betting
learn.html: Sports betting is a particularly dangerous and harmful game of chance. The book reports that Bosnia and Herzegovina has more betting shops per person than any other country in Europe: almost every village has one, about half a million people play games of chance every day (about one in eight), and betting shops are often placed just a few metres from schools. In many places today, betting ads and apps also target young people.

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: A fool relies on luck; a wise person relies – with Allah’s help – on their own hard work.

practice.title: Why is gambling forbidden?
practice.prompt: Tap every reason the book gives, then tap Check.

options.text: It is the work of Shaytan
It causes hatred and hostility between people
It turns people away from remembering Allah
It turns people away from Salah
Gamblers take other people’s property without effort

options.why: Not all games are forbidden – quizzes and games without money that don’t make us miss Salah are fine.

options.text: Because it is too easy to win
options.why: It is the opposite: almost everyone loses, and only one wins.

questions.q: In which surah does Allah call gambling the work of Shaytan (5:90)?
What should a person do who says to a friend, “Come, let’s gamble”?

options: It is played for money or something valuable, and one wins while the others lose

questions.q: Why is a quiz not gambling?
options: It is based on knowledge, not luck

questions.q: According to psychologists, gambling leads first to excitement, then to…
options: disappointment, and in the end hatred and hostility

questions.q: What does a wise person rely on?
options: Allah’s help and their own hard work

practice.title: Questions, tasks and talk
prompts: ❓ What does Allah (SWT) say about gambling? Why did He forbid it? What counts as gambling?
💬 Task 1: How would you explain the harm of gambling to a friend who thinks it is nothing bad? Write it in your maktab notebook.

🤝 Task 2: If you know someone who plays games of chance, try to show them its harmful results using what you learned. If you persuade even one person to stay away from betting, you have done a great deed.
🗣️ Talk with your muallim: “A fool relies on luck; a wise person relies, with Allah’s help, on their own hard work.”
